# Octen

Search Octen's real-time web index, extract web content, and create text or multimodal embeddings.

Category: Other. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/octen/.

## Actions

- **Broad Search** (read-only): Decompose one question into up to 30 sub-queries and search Octen's live web index concurrently.
- **Create Multimodal Embeddings** (read-only): Create independent or fused embeddings from up to 20 text, image, and URL-video elements.
- **Create Text Embeddings** (read-only): Create indexed text embeddings for up to 1,000 inputs with Octen in one metered request.
- **Extract URL Content** (read-only): Extract content and optional media or links from up to 20 URLs in one metered request.
- **Search Businesses** (read-only): Search Octen's web index once for business pages and optional company or person cards.
- **Search Images** (read-only): Search Octen's web image index from exactly one text query or reference image.
- **Search News** (read-only): Search live news once for ranked articles and optional event subjects.
- **Search Videos** (read-only): INVITE-ONLY BETA.
- **Search Web** (read-only): Search Octen's live web index once for ranked pages, with bounded filters, highlights, optional full content, and usage metadata.
